brief: The canvas displays an incomplete jigsaw puzzle composed of interlocking pieces. The edges of the puzzle are formed by individual, rigid shapes separated by visible seams. The viewer must interact by clicking and dragging pieces into their correct corresponding positions. As a piece snaps into place, the seam where the pieces interlock dramatically changes: the gap disappears, and the underlying image beneath the puzzle surface becomes visible, revealing fragments of the full, cohesive picture.

statement: This sketch presents an interactive jigsaw puzzle where users can drag and snap pieces into place. The interface shows a collection of irregularly shaped puzzle pieces floating on a background image, with the ability to click and drag them around the canvas. As pieces are moved and snapped into position, they become visible as part of the larger picture beneath the puzzle surface, revealing how they fit together. The interaction is designed for simple yet satisfying engagement, allowing users to manipulate the puzzle visually without complex controls or sound.
